tables.title: Tx Event FIFO element description
tables.text: Table 713, "Tx Event FIFO element description", in section 71.4.21 (FDCAN Tx event FIFO element) on page 3675. Columns: Field, Description. 10 data row(s).

rows:
E0 bit 31
ESI

Error state indicator
–0: Transmitting node is error active
–1: Transmitting node is error passive

E0 bit 30
XTD

Extended Identifier
–0: 11-bit standard identifier
–1: 29-bit extended identifier

E0 bit 29
RTR

Remote transmission request
–0: Transmit data frame
–1: Transmit remote frame

Identifier
Standard or extended identifier depending on bit XTD. A standard identifier must be 
written to ID[28:18].

Message marker
Copied from Tx buffer into Tx event FIFO element for identification of Tx message 
status.

E1 bits 23:22
EFC

Event type
–00: Reserved
–01: Tx event
–10: Transmission in spite of cancellation (always set for transmissions in DAR 
mode)
–11: Reserved

E1 bit 21
EDL

Extended data length
–0: Standard frame format
–1: FDCAN frame format (new DLC-coding and CRC)

E1 bit 20
BRS

Bitrate switching
–0: Frame transmitted without bitrate switching
–1: Frame transmitted with bitrate switching

T1 bits 19:16
DLC[3:0]

Data length code
–0 - 8: Frame with 0-8 data bytes transmitted
–9 - 15: Frame with eight data bytes transmitted

E1 bits 15:0
TXTS[15:0]

Tx timestamp
Timestamp counter value captured on start of frame transmission. Resolution 
depending on configuration of the timestamp counter prescaler FDCAN_TSCC.TCP.
